title: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE)
organization: IISc & IITs on behalf of National Coordination Board (GATE, MoE)
purpose: M.Tech / MS / Ph.D admissions at IITs, IISc, NITs AND direct Executive Trainee recruitment across Maharatna & Navratna PSUs (ONGC, IOCL, NTPC, BHEL, PGCIL, HPCL, BPCL, GAIL, SAIL, NHPC, BARC).
qualification: Bachelor degree holders in Engineering / Technology / Science / Architecture or candidates currently in 3rd or higher year.
branches_eligible: All 30 GATE papers (CS, EC, EE, ME, CE, CH, IN, DA - Data Science & AI, etc.)
age_limit: No age limit for GATE exam. PSU recruitment age limits typically 26 to 30 years (with category relaxations).
experience_required: Nil for fresh graduate trainee positions.
selection_process: Computer Based Test (CBT) -> Score valid for 3 years -> Individual PSU shortlisting based on GATE score followed by Personal Interview / GD.
exam_pattern: 65 Questions (100 Marks total), Duration: 3 Hours. General Aptitude (15 Marks) + Engineering Mathematics + Subject Paper (85 Marks). Question types: MCQs, MSQs, and NAT (Numerical Answer Type).
salary_pay_scale: PSU Executive Trainee (E-2 scale): Basic Rs 50,000 - 1,60,000. Annual CTC typically ranges from Rs 15 Lakhs to Rs 22 Lakhs per annum.

title: ISRO Scientist / Engineer 'SC'
organization: Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO Centralised Recruitment Board - ICRB)
purpose: Direct appointment as Scientist / Engineer 'SC' in national space centers (VSSC, URSC, SDSC SHAR, SAC, LPSC).
qualification: B.E. / B.Tech or equivalent in first class with aggregate minimum 65% marks or CGPA 6.84/10.
branches_eligible: Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Aerospace.
age_limit: Typically 28 years (Relaxations: OBC 3 yrs, SC/ST 5 yrs).
selection_process: Written Examination (Discipline specific objective questions) -> Interview with expert panel (Minimum 60% in interview mandatory).
exam_pattern: Part A: Core discipline questions (80 marks); Part B: Aptitude & Reasoning (20 marks).
salary_pay_scale: 7th CPC Level 10 (Rs 56,100 Basic + DA + HRA + Transport Allowance + Space Allowance). Gross starting ~Rs 90,000/month.

title: DRDO Scientist 'B' & CEPTAM Senior Technical Assistant (STA-B)
purpose: Indigenous defence R&D across missiles, avionics, radars, combat vehicles, naval systems, and artificial intelligence.
qualification: Scientist B: First class Bachelor Degree in Engineering or Master Degree in Science + Valid GATE Score. STA-B: 3-Year Diploma in Engineering or B.Sc in relevant subject.
branches_eligible: CSE, ECE, EEE, Mechanical, Civil, Metallurgy, Chemical, Aeronautical, Instrumentation.
age_limit: Scientist B: 28 years (General), 31 (OBC), 33 (SC/ST). CEPTAM: 18 to 28 years.
selection_process: Scientist B: Shortlisting via valid GATE score (1:10 ratio) followed by in-depth Technical Interview. CEPTAM: Tier-I CBT (Screening) + Tier-II CBT (Core technical selection).
salary_pay_scale: Scientist B: 7th CPC Level 10 (Rs 56,100). STA-B: 7th CPC Level 6 (Rs 35,400). Plus Defence Research Allowances.

title: BARC Scientific Officer (OCES / DGFS)
organization: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre, Department of Atomic Energy (DAE)
purpose: Nuclear science and technology research, reactor operations, radiation technologies across BARC, NPCIL, IGCAR.
qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc (Engineering) with minimum 60% aggregate marks in relevant discipline.
branches_eligible: Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, Instrumentation, Civil, Nuclear Engineering.
age_limit: 26 years for General, 29 for OBC, 31 for SC/ST.
selection_process: Online Screening Exam OR Valid GATE Score -> Comprehensive Interview by Technical Board at BARC Training School Mumbai.
salary_pay_scale: During 1-Year Training: Stipend Rs 55,000/month + book grant. On Appointment: Scientific Officer 'C' in 7th CPC Level 10 (Rs 56,100 + allowances).

title: Railway Recruitment Board Junior Engineer (RRB JE & SSE)
organization: Ministry of Railways, Government of India
purpose: Supervision and maintenance of rolling stock, locomotives, track infrastructure, signalling, and electrical traction across Indian Railways.
qualification: Diploma or Degree in Engineering in relevant branch (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, IT).
branches_eligible: Civil (Track/Bridges), Mechanical (C&W, Workshop), Electrical (Traction/General), Signal & Telecom, IT (Junior Engineer IT).
selection_process: CBT Stage 1 (Maths, Reasoning, General Science, General Awareness - 100 marks) -> CBT Stage 2 (General Awareness, Physics & Chemistry, Computer Basics, Environment, Technical Abilities - 150 marks) -> Document Verification & Medical Examination.
salary_pay_scale: RRB JE: 7th CPC Level 6 (Rs 35,400 Basic + Railway allowances). RRB SSE: Level 7 (Rs 44,900 Basic).

title: UPSC Engineering Services Examination (ESE / IES)
purpose: Highest technical bureaucracy in Government of India. Class 1 Gazetted Officers managing mega central engineering assets.
qualification: Degree in Engineering (B.Tech / B.E.) from recognized university or equivalent (Section A & B of AMIE).
disciplines: 1. Civil Engineering, 2. Mechanical Engineering, 3. Electrical Engineering, 4. Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering.
selection_process: Stage 1: Preliminary Exam (Paper I: General Studies & Engineering Aptitude - 200 marks; Paper II: Technical - 300 marks) -> Stage 2: Mains Exam (Two Conventional Papers - 300 marks each) -> Stage 3: Personality Test (Interview - 200 marks).
cadres_allotted: Central Public Works Department (CPWD), Military Engineer Services (MES), Indian Naval Armament Service, Central Water Engineering, Central Power Engineering Service, Border Roads Organisation (BRO).
salary_pay_scale: Assistant Executive Engineer: 7th CPC Level 10 (Rs 56,100 Basic + DA + HRA + Transport + Govt Quarters).

title: IBPS Specialist Officer (IT Officer Scale-I)
purpose: Core banking software management, cybersecurity, database administration, and digital banking platforms across 11 Public Sector Banks.
qualification: 4-Year Engineering Degree in Computer Science / Computer Applications / Information Technology / Electronics / Electronics & Telecommunications OR Post-Graduate Degree in relevant field.
branches_eligible: CSE, IT, ECE, EEE (Allied with IT)
selection_process: Online Preliminary Exam -> Online Mains Exam (Professional Knowledge in IT: DBMS, Networks, OS, DSA, Security) -> Common Interview.
salary_pay_scale: Junior Management Grade Scale I (JMGS-I): Scale Rs 36,000 - 63,840. Starting gross ~Rs 60,000 - 70,000/month + bank perks.

title: Airports Authority of India Junior Executive (Air Traffic Control & Technical)
organization: Airports Authority of India (AAI - Min of Civil Aviation)
purpose: Air Traffic Management, radar guidance, and communication navigation surveillance across all national and international airports in India.
qualification: JE (ATC): Full-time regular 3-Year B.Sc with Physics and Mathematics OR Full-time regular Bachelor degree in Engineering in any discipline (with Physics & Maths in any semester). JE (Technical): B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical or Automobile.
age_limit: Maximum 27 years (General), relaxations for OBC (3 yrs), SC/ST (5 yrs).
selection_process: Computer Based Online Examination (Part A: General Aptitude - 60 marks; Part B: Physics & Mathematics - 60 marks) -> Voice Test, Psychoactive Substances Test, and Background Verification.
salary_pay_scale: Executive (E-1 Scale): Basic Rs 40,000 - 1,40,000. Annual CTC approximately Rs 13 Lakhs to Rs 15 Lakhs per annum.

title: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) Project / Trainee Engineer
organization: Bharat Electronics Limited (Navratna PSU, Ministry of Defence)
purpose: Design, development, and manufacture of electronic equipment for the Indian Armed Forces (radars, sonars, weapon control, electronic warfare).
qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc (Engg) with minimum 55% marks (Pass class for SC/ST/PwD) in relevant branch.
branches_eligible: Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Mechanical, Computer Science, Electrical.
age_limit: 28 years for Project Engineer; 25 years for Trainee Engineer.
selection_process: Written Examination / Merit calculation + Personal Interview.
salary_pay_scale: Fixed term engagement with monthly consolidated remuneration starting at Rs 30,000 - 40,000 + medical and annual perks.

title: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
purpose: National supercomputing missions (PARAM supercomputers), AI computing, cryptography, multilingual computing, and embedded hardware.
qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / MCA in relevant discipline with first class.
branches_eligible: CSE, IT, ECE, EEE, AI/Data Science
age_limit: 30 to 35 years depending on post grade.
selection_process: Computer Based Online Test -> Technical Interview.
salary_pay_scale: Consolidated pay scales ranging from Rs 4.5 LPA to Rs 12 LPA depending on post.

title: State PSC Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE / AE)
organization: State Public Service Commissions (APPSC, TSPSC, TNPSC, MPSC, KPSC, etc.)
purpose: Execution and design of state irrigation projects, roads & buildings (R&B), panchayat raj engineering, public health, and municipal infrastructure.
qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering from a recognized university.
branches_eligible: Civil Engineering (Major share), Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering.
age_limit: 18 to 42/44 years (State specific age policies with broad eligibility).
selection_process: Computer Based Screening Test / Written Examination (Paper 1: General Studies & Mental Ability; Paper 2: Core Engineering Subject) -> Document Verification.
salary_pay_scale: Gazetted Engineering Pay Scale: Basic typically Rs 54,060 - 1,40,000 in revised state pay scales.
